candidate_axiom.name: Universal Grammar & Compositional Projection Constraints
candidate_axiom.statement: Every inter-module communication payload must conform to an invariant deep syntactic structure whose transformational projections into target representations preserve semantic well-formedness.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Data mutations or messages that cannot be projected from an unambiguous deep grammar AST are rejected by target compilers.

system_profile.archetype: Universal Grammar AST Deep Projection Compiler
system_profile.topology_type: Deep Syntax AST with Invariant Surface Projections
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Module Communication] ──> [Deep Grammar AST Parser]
                                       │
                        ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
                        ▼                             ▼
           [Projection Engine (Protobuf)]    [Projection Engine (JSON/REST)]
                        │                             │
                        └──────────────┬──────────────┘
                                       ▼
                       [Semantic Well-Formedness Guard]

Deep Syntax Validator.role: Parses all inter-module RPC payloads into a canonical deep-structure abstract syntax tree.
Deep Syntax Validator.invariant_rule: Rejects malformed messages prior to dispatch.

Transformational Projection Engine.role: Projects deep syntax ASTs into surface-level serialization formats without semantic loss.

Well-Formedness Guard.role: Verifies that received payloads comply with cross-module grammar agreements.
Well-Formedness Guard.invariant_rule: Payloads failing grammatical projection trigger compile-time rejection.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Ensures internal compiler ASTs maintain semantic consistency (+0.0080).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Standardizes telemetry stream formatting across heterogeneous observers (+0.0060).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Prevents malformed Byzantine message attacks via strict grammar verification (+0.0144).

tradeoffs.strengths: Eliminates serialization bugs and interface mismatch; provides universal schema validation.
tradeoffs.constraints: Adds parsing and schema validation step to payload ingest pipeline.

leaderboard.name: Linear Resource Ownership and The No-Cloning Invariant
leaderboard.statement: Every discrete capability, mutable memory buffer, or execution token must obey affine/linear type invariants; resources cannot be implicitly cloned or duplicated across concurrent processes, only transferred or consumed.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Subsystems attempting implicit cloning or aliasing of uncommitted resource tokens without explicit affine handoff trigger immediate compilation failure.

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Resource Producer] ──> [Linear Capability Token]
                                     │
                     ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                     ▼                               ▼
       [Exclusive Move / Handoff]        [Explicit Consume / Drop]
                     │                               │
                     ▼                               ▼
            [Destination Worker]             [Reclaimed Heap Buffer]

Affine Ownership Checker.role: Static compiler pass tracking capability token provenance and ownership lifetimes.
Affine Ownership Checker.invariant_rule: Prohibits shared mutable references; only single owners permitted.

Move Semantics Hand-off Bus.role: Facilitates zero-copy transfer of execution tokens across concurrent processes.
Move Semantics Hand-off Bus.invariant_rule: Transferring a token invalidates the sender's access capability.

Deterministic Drop Destructor.role: Automatically cleans up unconsumed resources at scope exit without garbage collection.
Deterministic Drop Destructor.invariant_rule: Every allocated token must be moved or dropped exactly once.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Prevents memory leaks and duplicate execution in self-compilation (+0.0080).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Guarantees telemetry packets are processed exactly once (+0.0060).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Eliminates double-spend and duplicate message attacks in consensus (+0.0096).

tradeoffs.strengths: Zero-cost memory safety without GC pauses; prevents data races by construction.
tradeoffs.constraints: Strict ownership hierarchy requires deliberate explicit borrowing design.

leaderboard.name: Phenomenological Horizon & Intentional Bracketing (Epoché)
leaderboard.statement: Speculative execution modules must establish explicit intentional horizons, bracketing internal transient states until external observation boundaries are reached, preventing premature commitment of speculative paths.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Speculative internal mutations must remain bracketed within intentional horizons and are prohibited from escaping to global observation streams before epoch reconciliation.

system_profile.topology_type: Bracketed Epoche Sandbox with Observation Barrier
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Speculative Task] ──> [Bracketed Execution Horizon]
                                    │
                    ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                    ▼                               ▼
       [Transient State Sandbox]         [Epoch Reconciliation Barrier]
                    │                               │
                    └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    ▼
                     [Global Observable State Stream]

Intentional Bracketing Chamber.role: Isolates speculative state mutations within an unobserved execution horizon.
Intentional Bracketing Chamber.invariant_rule: Prohibits leakage of speculative mutations to external processes.

Epoch Reconciliation Barrier.role: Synchronizes and commits speculative states only upon verification completion.
Epoch Reconciliation Barrier.invariant_rule: Failed speculative branches are discarded with zero trace.

Observation Horizon Firewall.role: Prevents external observers from viewing intermediate uncommitted states.
Observation Horizon Firewall.invariant_rule: Guarantees atomic visibility of speculative batches.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Enables safe speculative compilation paths without contaminating master state (+0.0060).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Prevents premature telemetry emissions from uncommitted branches (+0.0060).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Provides clean speculative execution in Byzantine state machine replication (+0.0096).

tradeoffs.strengths: Allows highly aggressive speculative execution without roll-back side effects.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires temporary memory buffering for bracketed state branches.
